scope: Synthetic 3-variable non-Gaussian pilot. Not real multimodal data. One fixed model seed. No consistency loss and no model sweep.
preserved_records: v1 EH1 FAIL, calibration v2 never-run/superseded, calibration v3 PASS (not re-run), model-stage STOP record.

seeds.data: seed_v2(seed, experiment, joint='mixture3', condition='data', example='all', replicate=0, branch=<train|dev|test>)
seeds.model: seed_v2(seed, ..., condition=<model>, branch='model_init') for EM initialisation and (if run) FM training

source_distribution.type: finite Gaussian mixture over (x, y, z), fixed before any data were generated
source_distribution.pd_check_at_registration: Cholesky succeeds for all 3 components; log-determinants -3.316, -3.534, -3.434; minimum Cholesky diagonal 0.458
source_distribution.note: parameters chosen once for multimodal, non-Gaussian conditionals with z not independent of x given y within components 2 and 3; not tuned for any test outcome

splits.use: train: fitting and standardisation sds; dev: pipeline smoke and (for FM) the solver-level choice only; test: reported results

standardisation: y and z divided by their train-split sample sds

TRUE_JOINT_CONTROL.definition: analytic marginals/conditionals of the exact source mixture; JOINT_COHERENT_CONTROL with exact quality

FITTED_JOINT_CONTROL.definition: EM-fitted Gaussian mixture on train only; all conditionals and marginals computed analytically from the same normalized density (JOINT_COHERENT_CONTROL)
FITTED_JOINT_CONTROL.misspecified: yes, declared before fitting: K_fit = 2 < K = 3, so fit quality is imperfect by design while coherence holds exactly

em.init: k-means++-style seeding with the model seed

FITTED_JOINT_CONTROL.not_a: not an equal-budget baseline for flow models

INDEPENDENT_CONDITIONAL_FM.blocker: no CPU tensor library (numpy/PyTorch absent); installation not approved

design.budget_note: same total updates as the independent arm; parameter counts differ and are recorded, not equalised

solver_for_fm.rule: levels chosen on dev only; both levels reported on test; 'numerically stable' only if |T_fine - T_coarse| <= 1.645 x combined SE of the example means; two levels do not prove convergence

evaluation.test: Test P (within-example relabelling), N = 200, M = 64, B = 199, statistic mean ED_V on standardised scale, upper tail
evaluation.primary: target: direct z|x vs sequential (y ~ q(y|x), then z ~ q(z|x,y)); a fresh y per sample; branches on independent streams
evaluation.secondary: projected joint: direct q(y,z|x) vs sequential (y, z) pairs; 8 fixed directions; vectors relabelled as units; equality of 8 projected laws only
evaluation.effect_size: mean ED_U(direct_i, sequential_i) over examples with a normal 95% CI (unbiased for the mean population gap)
evaluation.quality_to_truth: closed form for GMM models: per-example energy distance between the model's direct z|x and the true z|x (CRPS divergence = ED/2); projected-joint analogue; sample sd ratio vs the true conditional sd
evaluation.families: primary family = the target tests of the models actually run (2 here, Holm-adjusted p also reported); secondary joint tests descriptive. With B = 199 the p grid step is 0.005; a planned 4-model primary family (alpha/4 = 0.0125) remains attainable
evaluation.interpretation: TRUE and FITTED controls are coherent by construction (population gaps exactly 0; proof: mixture weights collapse, see gmm.py and the quadrature fixture). A rejection is not an automatic FAIL; it triggers only the declared checks (fixture tests, stream independence). FITTED is expected to have worse quality than TRUE while remaining coherent.

decision_table_categories: separate vs shared learner gap and quality/cost (NOT_RUN)
gap explained by solver refinement vs remaining (NOT_RUN: no solver in the GMM controls)
non-detection vs equality / correctness / global joint existence
fm_outcome_labels: MODEL_FIT_OR_NUMERICS_INCONCLUSIVE if training is insufficient or the two solver levels disagree; that is not evidence of incompatibility

budget.note: within the standing first-verification cap (CPU <= 2 threads, 120 s synthetic run)

stop_rule: run once with the registered seeds; do not change data, K_fit, EM settings, N, M, B or seeds after seeing results
